stories.title: Smoke test gate — poll cycle + recommendation output
stories.description: Human verifies the full poll cycle produces a visible recommendation with a sensible rationale. This gate exists because poll → snapshot → recommend → display is the core value proposition — it must work end-to-end before snapshot baselines are locked in.
reviewInstructions: Run: bash scripts/ralph/smoke_test.sh — must still pass 0 failures
Run: fom watch BNE SYD 2026-07-20 2026-07-27 --label 'Test'
Run: fom poll --dry-run — should list the trip without crashing
Insert stub snapshots (no API key needed): uv run python scripts/ralph/insert_stub_snapshot.py 1 --count 5
Run: fom check 1 — recommendation panel must show: decision badge, true cost in AUD, confidence %, rationale text (must be a real English sentence, not empty or 'None')
Run: fom history 1 — sparkline must render without error (even 5 points is enough)
Run: fom status — trip must appear with decision badge (MONITOR / WAIT / BOOK NOW)
Run: fom status --all — same trip visible
Check: subject line of any email would say '[fly-o-myte]' not '[Travo]'
Run: fom remove 1 --yes — clean up
If all output looks correct and sensible, create scripts/ralph/demo-reviews/DR-B-approved.md

stories.title: Syrupy snapshot tests for Rich output

reviewInstructions: Seed data: fom watch BNE SYD 2026-07-20 2026-07-27 --label 'Easter' && uv run python scripts/ralph/insert_stub_snapshot.py 1 --count 10

status: table rows with trip label, route, decision badge (colour), true cost in AUD
check: full recommendation panel showing cost breakdown, confidence %, rationale sentence
compare: two-column table with matching headers, no truncation
If output looks correct: create scripts/ralph/demo-reviews/S15-approved.md
After approval ralph commits the snapshot files and sets passes:true
acceptanceCriteria: Syrupy snapshot files committed under tests/__snapshots__/
